_doc: How each cell of a hero's ornaments sheet (row by row, 3 x 3) is placed. win: a window, front, on the shaft. deco: a front-facing piece, on the shaft. hang: hangs from its top (chains, a rack). banner: the hero's hanging banner; hangs from its top, and turned on its side it is also the cloth of the castle's flags. ivy: climbing plants, moss or grass; hangs from its top, and the only thing laid on a curtain wall. edgeR / edgeL: seen from the side, fixed to a wall on its left / right, so it sits on the tower's right / left edge, sticking out. bal: a balcony with no window, set under a window. balD: a balcony or gallery with its own door. x: unused.
